name: coadmap
description:
Coadmap is an AI-driven project management platform that structures your projects and products around customer value, proactively supported by "Yata," an AI Project Manager (AIPM). Information is connected across three layers — "why we build it" (customer value & objectives), "what we build it" (features), and "how we build it" (tasks) — so both humans and AI can work with a project's full context.

By connecting this connector, Claude can directly reference and act on your project context in Coadmap.

Key capabilities

* Tasks & epics: create, update, and comment; retrieve dependencies, progress, and schedules
* Features & spec notes: reference, create, and edit sections of specs and meeting notes tied to customer value and features
* Product structure: browse and edit the component / feature hierarchy
* Releases, initiatives & risks: create, update, and review
* Context retrieval: get workspace-wide status and your team's adopted knowledge
* PM consultation: ask the AIPM "Yata" about prioritization and sequencing

Example use cases

* From Claude Code, pull the background, acceptance criteria, and related specs for "today's task" and start implementing right away
* Bulk-create tasks and epics from meeting notes or discussion threads
* Reflect spec changes from implementation into feature notes and update related tasks in one go
* Trace "when and why did this spec end up this way?" through timelines and team knowledge

Connecting requires a Coadmap account (MCP features are available on the Standard plan and above). Authorization uses OAuth 2.0, and the connector securely accesses only the data in workspaces the user can access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add coadmap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add coadmap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.coadmap.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the coadmap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: coadmap lists 58 MCP tools, including add_coadmap_free_input_to_my_stack, add_coadmap_risk_evidence, add_coadmap_stackable_to_my_stack, append_coadmap_note_section, attach_coadmap_drive_file, consult_coadmap_pm, create_coadmap_drive_direct_upload, create_coadmap_epic, create_coadmap_initiative, create_coadmap_note, create_coadmap_pdm_subject_comment, and create_coadmap_product_domain.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to coadmap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to coadmap in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
coadmap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
coadmap is developed by Coadmap Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
